source: 544 Threat
target: 544 Minatio

source: Professor agreed with Lumian’s suggestion, believing it could help verify certain things.
target: Professor consentiit suggestioni Lumiani, credens illud posse ad quaedam certiora comprobanda efficere.

source: Both Professor and Associate Professor went to another team and found Stonemason, who was known for crafting mystical items.
target: Et Professor atque Professor Associatus ad aliam turmam accesserunt et Lapidarium invenerunt, qui notus erat ad res mysticas conficiendas.

source: Dressed in a doctor’s white coat with a saucepan over his head, Stonemason’s azure eyes focused on the Academy Warlocks through two specially dug holes.
target: Indutus veste alba medica cum sartagine super caput, oculi caerulei Lapidarii incantatores Academiae per duas specialiter foditas foramina intuebantur.

source: He nodded and said, “Recently, I’ve also been having strange dreams related to a wilderness.
target: Caput inclinavit et dixit: “Nuper etiam somnia mira pertinebant ad desertum.

source: However, in addition to the endless wilderness and wandering figures, there are also some peculiar scenes in my dreams.”
target: At praeter infinita deserta et vagantes figuras, nonnulla scaena insolita in somniis meis apparuerunt.”

source: As expected, it affects the neighboring pathways of Mystery Pryer and Savant…
target: Ut exspectabatur, hoc semitas vicinas Mystery Pryer et Savant afficit…

source: Lumian nodded slightly as Professor pressed further, “What scenes are they?”
target: Lumian leviter inclinavit, dum Professor ulterius interrogabat, “Quae scaenae sunt illae?”

source: Stonemason’s voice echoed within the saucepan.
target: Vox Lapidarii intra sartaginem resonavit.

source: “I see scenes of primitive humans independently creating fire for the first time.
target: “Video scaenas hominum primitivorum, qui ignem primo tempore sui ipsorum more creant.

source: Ancient humans making sacrifices to the sky and land.
target: Antiqui homines, caelum et terram sacrificabant.

source: There were many similar scenes, but they were very vague.
target: Multae similes scaenae erant, sed erant valde indistinctae.

source: I was in a dream and couldn’t scrutinize them carefully.
target: In somnio eram neque eas diligenter perscrutari poteram.

source: I can’t remember the exact situations clearly.
target: Non possum exactas res clare meminisse.

source: “According to the Savant pathway’s Beyonders, this is a fragment of civilization.”
target: “Secundum Beyonders semitae Savant, hoc est fragmentum civilizationis.”

source: Upon hearing Stonemason’s response, Lumian’s forehead twitched imperceptibly.
target: Audito responsu Lapidarii, frons Lumiani vix perceptibiliter contremuit.

source: It reminded him of the moment he heard a peculiar sound accompanying scenes while wearing the Mystery Prying Eye in Fourth Epoch Trier!
target: Illud illi reminiscibatur tempore quo sonum peculiare audiverat, qui scaenas comitabatur, dum Oculum Mystery Pryer in Quarta Epoch Trier gerebat!

source: As the scenes unfolded, a chorus of voices echoed one name: Celestial Master!
target: Dum scaenae patebant, chorus vocum unum nomen resonabat: Magister Caelestis!

source: Was what I received a fragment of a civilization?
target: Num id quod accepi erat fragmentum civilizationis?

source: The Eye of Truth correspond to the Mystery Pryer pathway.
target: Oculus Veritatis semitae Mystery Pryer respondet.

source: Upon their use, they activated the powers of neighboring pathways, revealing corresponding sounds?
target: Eorum usu, vires semitarum vicinarum excitaverunt, revelantes sonos correspondentes?

source: But there is a prerequisite, a special environment…
target: Sed est praevia condicio, ambitus peculiaris…

source: Fourth Epoch Trier holds remnants of advanced powers from the Mystery Pryer and Savant pathways.
target: Trier, in Quarta Epoch, reliquias virium provectarum ex semitis Mystery Pryer et Savant continet.

source: Celestial Master—the term is similar to the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings which influences Seer, Apprentice, and Marauder pathways.
target: Magister Caelestis—terminus hic similis est Caelesti Honorabili Caeli et Terrae pro Benedictionibus, qui semitas Videntis, Discipuli, et Praedonis afficit.

source: Meanwhile, Celestial Master correlates with the Mystery Pryer and Savant pathways.
target: Interim, Magister Caelestis semitis Mystery Pryer et Savant convenit.

source: Lumian fell into deep thought after his initial shock.
target: Lumian post primum stupefactum in altam meditationem incidit.

source: Franca glanced at him, perplexed by his limited participation in the discussion.
target: Franca eum intuebatur, perplexa parvae eius participationis in disputatione.

source: After a moment, Lumian snapped out of his daze.
target: Post aliquantum, Lumian ex sua torpore evigilavit.

source: Considering Professor, Stonemason, and others’ speculations, he carefully stated, “The sudden downpour in Trier is an outward manifestation of a catastrophe, much like the Deep Valley Cloister.
target: Consideratis speculationibus Professoris, Lapidarii, et aliorum, Lumian caute dixit: “Impromptus imber in Trier est externa species cladis, similis Claustri Vallis Profundae.

source: “I suspect that a high-level power leaked during the catastrophe, affecting Beyonders from two neighboring pathways.
target: Suspicio est quod potentia altissima in clade effusa sit, afficiens Beyonders ex duabus semitis vicinarum.

source: The impact is more pronounced for those in Trier but relatively minor for those outside.”
target: Impulsus in Trier magis notabilis est, sed extra parvus.

source: At this point, Lumian smirked.
target: Ad hoc, Lumian subridens egit.

source: “I’ve observed that Warlocks outside Trier experienced significant decreases in the frequency and clarity of their wilderness dreams.
target: “Animadverti Incantatores extra Trier in frequentia et claritate somniorum de solitudine significanter diminutos esse.

source: Strangely, none of the Warlocks in Trier mentioned this.”
target: Inusitatum est, nullus Incantator in Trier hoc dixerit.

source: Bear in a brown bear skin suit nodded approvingly.
target: Ursa, induta veste ex cute ursi fusci, approbans inclinavit.

source: Professor and others concurred with Lumian’s hypothesis, relieved that the situation was indeed improving.
target: Professor atque alii cum hypothesi Lumiani consenserunt, solati quod res vere meliorabantur.

source: They couldn’t help but marvel at Muggle’s remarkable growth after surviving the April Fool’s trap.
target: Non potuerunt non mirari mirabili incrementu Muggle, postquam insidias Aprilis Stultorum superaverat.

source: Franca then inquired about the owner of the ancient tomb beside the Crazy Mushroom Cave in Trier’s catacombs.
target: Franca deinde quaesivit de domino sepulchri antiquati iuxta Specum Fungorum Insaniae in catacumbis Trier.

source: No one knew the answer.
target: Nemo responsum sciebat.

source: The Warlocks in Trier offered to assist in the investigation, but there were no guarantees of finding anything.
target: Incantatores in Trier auxilium ferre in investigatione obtulerunt, sed nulla fides erat aliquid inveniendi.

source: Franca had already entrusted this matter to 007.
target: Franca iam hanc rem 007 committerat.

source: Her current focus was on uncovering any Mirror People who might have infiltrated the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society, thanks to Lumian’s teachings.
target: Praesens eius cura erat in detegendo quibusvis Hominibus Specularibus, qui fortasse in Societatem Inquisitionis Baboonum Crispor Capillorum penetraverunt, gratia Lumiani doctrinae.

source: After agreeing on the reward, she left the Academy team and headed towards Hela.
target: Post consensum de praemio, illa turmam Academiae reliquit et versus Helam se contulit.

source: After discussing the Mirror People situation with Hela, Lumian emerged from the corner where the Academy team was located, ready to gather mysticism knowledge from the death domain with the Purgatory team.
target: Postquam de re Hominum Specularium cum Hela disseruerunt, Lumian e angulo ubi turba Academiae collocata erat emergens, paratus scientiam mysticam ex dominio mortis cum turba Purgatorii colligere.

source: Franca immediately approached Lumian, lowered her voice, and asked with a smile, “What were you thinking when Stonemason recounted his dream? It seemed like you had thought of something important.”
target: Franca statim ad Lumian accessit, vocem minuendo, et subrisu quaesivit: “Quid cogitabas cum Lapidarius somnium suum narravit? Videbatur quasi aliquid magni momenti excogitaveris.”

source: Hadn’t I shared what I saw and heard after using the Eye of Truth underground?
target: Num non communicaveram id quod vidi et audivi postquam Oculus Veritatis subterraneus usus sum?

source: That shouldn’t be the case.
target: Non oportet ita esse.

source: I won’t forget sharing matters involving the Celestial Master with Franca…
target: Non obliviscar de rebus ad Magister Caelestis pertinentibus cum Franca communicasse…

source: Lumian’s heart suddenly stirred, feeling that his spirituality was hindering this matter.
target: Cor Lumiani repente concitatus est, sentiens spiritualitatem suam rem hanc impedire.

source: After a moment of contemplation, he responded, “It’s rather complicated and involves high-level powers. I’ll write to Madam Magician later and see if I can share it with you.”
target: Post aliquod cogitandi tempus, respondit: “Haec satis implicata sunt et potentias altiores involvunt. Postea ad Magistram Magicam scribam et videam an tecum communicare possim.”

source: “All right,” Franca said eagerly. “Don’t forget!”
target: “Recte,” Franca acriter dixit. “Noli oblivisci!”

source: Her curiosity was piqued.
target: Curiositas eius excitata est.

source: At that moment, Hela, still dressed as a black widow, approached Lumian and asked, “Any progress in tracking Ultraman and Bard?”
target: Illo momento, Hela, adhuc induta ut nora atra, ad Lumian accessit et rogavit, “Quid progressum est in vestigatione Ultraman et Bard?”

source: “Not at the moment. I’m still compiling the necessary information,” Lumian replied truthfully.
target: “Non adhuc. Pergam colligens informationes necessarias,” Lumian veraciter respondit.

source: Hela nodded slightly and replied, “If you need assistance, don’t hesitate to reach out to me or Gandalf.”
target: Hela leviter inclinavit et respondit, “Si auxilio indiges, noli dubitare me aut Gandalf adire.”

source: The primary objective for most members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society was to eliminate the April Fool’s traitors.
target: Propositum principale plurimorum membrorum Societatis Inquisitionis Baboonum Crispor Capillorum erat perditores Aprilis Stultorum tollere.

source: “Got it.” Lumian had no plans to confront the key members of April Fool’s on his own.
target: “Intelligo.” Lumian consilia non habebat claves membrorum Aprilis Stultorum solus oppugnandi.

source: Undoubtedly, it was optimal for him to carry out the final execution.
target: Indubitanter, optimum fuit ei ultimam exsecutionem perficere.

source: Upon returning to the real world, Lumian noticed that night was falling.
target: Revertens in mundum reale, Lumian animadvertit noctem cadere.

source: He set out a stack of late-night snacks for Ludwig and summoned Madam Magician’s messenger.
target: Paravit ac composuit catervam eduliorum nocturnorum ad Ludwigum et advocavit nuntium Magistram Magicam.

source: After freshening up—washing his face, brushing his teeth, and snuffing out the wall lamp—he settled into bed.
target: Postquam se refecerat—vultum lavans, dentes purgans, et lampam muralem exstinguens—in lecto se collocavit.

source: Just then, a sense of alertness surged through him.
target: Tunc, sensus vigilantiae per eum subito pervagatus est.

source: He sat up suddenly, focusing on a specific spot in the room.
target: Subito evigilavit, in certo loco in camera intendens.

source: Outside the window, a faint crimson glow shimmered.
target: Extra fenestram, tenuus ruber splendor micabat.

source: In one corner, a shadow swiftly expanded, reaching up to the ceiling, forming a silhouette resembling two goat horns.
target: In uno angulo, umbra celeriter se propagavit, usque ad laquearia perveniens, figuram efformans quae duo cornua caprarum similia videbatur.

source: It was as if a devil had emerged from the dark abyss.
target: Sicut si diabolus e profundo tenebrarum abysso emergisset.

source: Lumian’s eyebrows twitched as he stared at the colossal black shadow.
target: Supercilia Lumiani concitata sunt dum ingentem umbram nigram intuebatur.

source: The devil-like shadow resonated with a deep and imposing voice.
target: Umbra, quasi diabolus, resonabat voce profunda et imponente.

source: “Lowly human, you must answer my question truthfully.”
target: “Humane ignobilis, quaestioni meae veraciter respondeas.”

source: It spoke in Intisian.
target: In Intisiana lingua locutus est.

source: Lumian cracked his neck gently and asked, “What’s the question?”
target: Lumian leniter collum flectit et quaesivit: “Quaestio quid est?”

source: The devilish figure rumbled in a deep tone, “What did the Paco family’s Giorgia hire you to do?”
target: Figura diabolica in voce profunda rugivit: “Quid tibi familiae Paco, a Giorgia, curavit ut faceres?”

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “What do human affairs have to do with a devil like you? I’m a professional adventurer. I won’t betray my employer.”
target: “Quid res humanas ad te, diabolus, attinet? Ego sum peritus viator. Dominum meum non proderim.”

source: The devilish shadow growled, “Then I’ll use your blood as the answer!”
target: Umbra diabolica rugivit: “Tum sanguinem tuum ut responsum adhibebo!”

source: Before it completed its sentence, its aura surged, and the crimson moonlight in the room instantly succumbed to darkness, shrouding the space in a chilling aura.
target: Antequam sententiam finiret, aura eius insurgens est, et lux rubra lunae in conclavi statim in tenebras cecidit, spatium in aura frigida circumdata.

source: The corners of Lumian’s mouth curled up.
target: Anguli buccarum Lumiani incurvati sunt.

source: With a swift press of his left hand, he catapulted from the bed like a cheetah, propelling himself towards the ceiling.
target: Celeriter, manu sinistra premit, se ex lecto proiecit velut cheetah, se ad laquearia impellens.

source: Overhead, darkness enveloped him, resembling an abyssal reflection.
target: Supra, tenebrae eum circumtexebantur, repraesentantes speciem abyssi.

source: In a sudden twist, Lumian’s body turned pitch black, almost zero in thickness.
target: In subito conversione, corpus Lumiani totum atrum factum est, fere nullo spissitudinis.

source: He morphed into a shadow creature and seamlessly melded into the darkness!
target: Mutatus est in creaturam umbratilis, atque sine intermissione in tenebras se incorporavit!

source: Within the dimly illuminated fishnet of shadows, Lumian spotted the “devil.”
target: In rete tenebrarum vix illuminatarum, Lumian “diabolum” animadvertit.

source: Standing just over a meter tall, the creature was child-sized, yet its skin was creased like that of an elderly man in his seventies or eighties.
target: Stans paulo plus quam uno metro altus, creatura erat parva ut infans, sed cutis eius plicata erat sicut senis septuagenarii aut octogenarii.

source: Its disproportionately large head featured protruding eyes, presenting a grotesque visage that was beyond Lumian’s knowledge of creatures.
target: Caput eius, disproportionate magnum, oculis eminentibus ornatum, faciem abominabilem exhibebat, quae ultra notitiam Lumiani de creaturis patebat.

source: In the form of a shadow, Lumian “swam” toward it, aiming to ensnare the peculiar creature that manifested the devil’s projection. He planned on pulling it out of the darkness and controlling it with the Spell of Harrumph.
target: In forma umbratilis, Lumian ad illam “natavit”, studens capere illam creaturam peculiaram, quae manifestationem diaboli praebebat. Consilium cepit eam ex tenebris traere et incantatione Harrumph subigere.

source: Many of Lumian’s abilities were constrained in the shadow creature form.
target: Multae facultates Lumiani in forma creaturae umbratilis coartatae erant.

source: The short, malevolent creature with wrinkled skin appeared defenseless against the shadow’s entanglement, surprising Lumian, who had anticipated fierce resistance.
target: Creatura parva, maligna, cum cute rugosa, defensionem carentem videbatur adversus vincula umbrae, quod Lumian, acri repugnatione expectata, miratus est.

source: Without hesitation, he prepared to depart, leaving the shadow to detain its captive.
target: Sine mora, se parare discedere constitui, relinquens umbram captivum retinere.

source: Just then, the darkness surrounding him brightened, illuminated by the light from the “sky.”
target: Ille instante, tenebrae circa eum clarificatae sunt, luce e “caelo” data.

source: Instinctively, Lumian looked up and witnessed the pure darkness rapidly dissolving, unveiling a colossal star hanging in the void.
target: Instinctive, Lumian surrexit et conspexit puras tenebras celeriter evanescere, revelantes ingentem stellam in vacuo pendere.

source: The star bore a faint blue hue, resembling a demonic eye.
target: Stella tenuit levem nuancem caeruleam, quae oculo daemoni similis videbatur.

source: In an instant, Lumian felt his blood freeze, involuntarily snapping out of his shadow creature form.
target: In uno instante, Lumian sensit sanguinem suum congelari, et involuntarie ex forma umbratili evanescere.

source: The big-headed “shorty,” adorned with wrinkles, seized the chance to break free from its constraints, swiftly merging into the pale-blue starlight and disappearing from sight.
target: Parvus cum capite ingenti, rugulis ornatus, occasionem arripuit ut a vinculis evaderet, celeriter in lucem pallidae caeruleae stellarum miscentem et evanescens a conspectu factus est.

source: After a moment, Lumian fully recovered. He stared at the now-normal room, sinking into contemplation.
target: Post aliquod tempus, Lumian plene restitutus est. In camera iam normali conspecta, in meditatione cecidit.

source: What in the world was that thing? It seemed so weak, yet it came to intimidate me!
target: Quid erat iste in mundo? Videbatur tam infirmum, sed ad me terrendum venerat!

source: Nevertheless, the blinking star held an air of peculiarity.
target: Attamen, stella micans aerem singularitatis habebat.

source: Why not just send the star to frighten me right away? After suppressing me, it didn’t seize the opportunity to attack. Even though I regained some mobility upon escaping the shadows, I was still relatively slow… Lumian mused silently.
target: Cur non statim stellam mittebis ad me terrendum? Postquam me opprimas, occasionem ad oppugnandum non arripuit. Etsi aliquam mobilitatem recuperavi ex umbris effugiens, adhuc tardus eram… Lumian tacite meditatus est.

source: While he couldn’t grasp the full picture, certain details became apparent.
target: Cum totam imaginem comprehendere non posset, quaedam indicia manifesta facta sunt.

source: No wonder Giorgia didn’t casually enlist a foreign adventurer with Beyonder powers to handle the humanoid lizard.
target: Non mirum est quod Giorgia non leveciter extraneum viatorem cum Beyonder viribus conscripsit, ad tractandum lacertam humanoidem.

source: Someone lurking in the shadows would interrogate me about the entire matter in the future.
target: Aliquis latens in umbris me de tota re in futurum interrogabit.

source: Only a renowned adventurer like Louis Berry, capable of hunting Demon Warlocks, can resist it.
target: Solus praeclarus viator, Louis Berry, qui Demon Incantatores venari potest, id repugnare potest.

source: Heh heh, earning 15,000 risot isn’t a walk in the park…
target: Heh heh, lucrari 15,000 risot non est ambulatio in horto…

source: The one in the shadows knows Louis Berry isn’t weak, so they didn’t dare to attack directly. Instead, they dispatched a small monster with unique abilities to intimidate me, hoping to extract information?
target: Qui in umbris latet novit Louis Berry non debilem esse, itaque non ausi sunt directe oppugnare. Pro eo, parvum monstrum cum singularibus facultatibus delegaverunt, sperantes me intimidare atque informationes extrahere.

source: Why not go to Giorgia’s house and ask? Their family doesn’t seem to possess any superpowers…
target: Cur non ad domum Giorgiae pergeris et quaeres? Familia eorum videtur nullas vires supernaturales habere…

source: Is this an internal conflict within the Fisheries Company and the Fisheries Guild?
target: Numquid hic internus conflictus est intra Societatem Piscandi et Gremium Piscandi?

source: Yes, it’s an opportunity to interact more deeply with the Paco family and understand the core process of the sea prayer ritual…
target: Ita, est occasio ad profundiorem commercium cum familia Paco et ad intellegendum processum cardinalem rituum orationis maris…

source: Shaking his head, Lumian reclined on the bed and resumed his slumber.
target: Caput movens, Lumian in lecto recubuit et somnum iterum ceperit.

source: Around 8 a.m. the next day, Lugano, who had gone out to buy breakfast, rushed back and said to Lumian, “Boss, those combat nuns are looking for you!”
target: Circiter hora octava mane die sequente, Lugano, qui ad ientaculum emendum exierat, festinanter rediit et Lumiano dixit: “Domine, illae moniales pugnantes te quaerunt!”
